- Production Rate: 1 item every 10 minutes and 12 seconds
- Power Required: 3 Units
- Lockable: Yes

__Build Information__

- CAMP Build Limit: 1 per camp
- Workshop Build Limit: 1 per workshop
- Build Menu Category: Resources
- Shelter Use: No
- Flamingo Units (CAMP Budget Cost): 2

__Crafting Requirements__

- 5x Steel

__Capacity__

- Storage: Holds up to 6 pounds of random suspicious items.

## **__How to Unlock__**

__How to Unlock__
